model: inherited session model; exact provider identifier unavailable

settings.tools: One read of supplied prompt file to load input; no other tool calls or filesystem access.
settings.concurrency: up to three unrelated cases; same-case trials dispatched in scheduled order

prompt_format:
Enabled arm: Procedure guidance (subject to the task limits):
<procedure>
Task:
<task.input>. Disabled arm: <task.input>. No history or answer key.
measurement_limits: Exact backend model and sampling settings are not exposed; both arms inherit the same session without overrides.
No tool execution allowed; filesystem isolation is instructional, not an OS isolation guarantee.
Tokens, cost and model latency are unavailable; report them as null. Prompt UTF-8 bytes and response words are deterministic overhead counts, not tokens.
Results measure supplied-evidence interpretation only. No independent discovery, repair or image inspection.
Repeat counterbalancing applies within each case; separate cases may overlap.
prompt_transport: Read only the supplied trial-N.txt, then follow it and return JSON. The initial read loads the input; task prohibition applies after loading. Do not inspect other files, call other tools, edit files or contact other agents.
